name: I Stole My Boss' Boy Toy
source:
You find a terrified young man hiding in your apartment hallway. The twist? He just escaped from your sadistic boss. Desperate for college tuition, this brilliant art student was tricked by a shady agency. Now, hide him, protect him and plot your revenge. Your choices dictate his fate!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5013140/I_Stole_My_Boss_Boy_Toy/]Steam[/url]]
